newsitem.title: USA: SkyWest February load factor falls.
newsitem.headline: SkyWest February load factor falls.

text.p: SkyWest Airlines Inc said on Tuesday that its load factor for February fell 1.8 percentage points to 49.7 percent from 51.5 percent in February 1996.

The carrier reported a 5.1 percent increase in revenue passenger miles for February to 56.5 million, while available seat miles increased 8.8 percent to 113.7 million compared to the same period last year.
Passenger boardings for February totaled 214,661, a 5.6 percent increase over February 1996.
